title: Keyboard manager newly doesn't detect Airplane mode key

status.label: Awaiting current Lenovo hotkey details
status.detail: PowerToys 0.92.1 captured the airplane-mode key as Win+A previously, but it now toggles airplane mode without being detected. The laptop model and current-build behavior are unconfirmed.

judgment.rationale: The reporter describes a Lenovo IdeaPad 5 Pro 14ARH7 where the airplane-mode/F8 button previously appeared as Win+A but now toggles airplane mode directly and is not captured by Keyboard Manager; Fn+F8 is recognized as F8. The only tested build is 0.92.1 on Windows 11 build 26100.4484. The key may be handled as an OEM/ACPI hotkey rather than a standard keyboard event, but a current-build test and exact Fn mode are needed before concluding it is unsupported.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.92.1, Lenovo IdeaPad 5 Pro 14ARH7, and Windows 11 build 26100.4484.
The airplane-mode button previously appeared as Win+A and was remapped; now it toggles airplane mode directly and is not detected, while Fn+F8 is recognized as F8.
The issue has no comments or diagnostic archive and remains open and unassigned.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for a v0.102.3001 retest with the exact Fn/hotkey mode and a fresh /bugreport if the physical airplane-mode key remains undetected.

fix_assessment.rationale: The key may have changed from a standard Win+A sequence to a firmware/OS airplane-mode hotkey that Keyboard Manager cannot observe, but no current-build capture or diagnostic confirms the event path.

proposed_fixes.title: Support the airplane-mode key if Windows exposes it as a keyboard event
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The laptop's airplane-mode button may now be handled by firmware or Windows as a system hotkey rather than the Win+A keyboard sequence previously observed, leaving Keyboard Manager with no remappable key event.
plan: Retest on v0.102.3001 with the stated Lenovo model and Fn/hotkey mode, comparing the physical airplane-mode button with Fn+F8 in the remap capture dialog.
Use the fresh diagnostic to confirm whether Windows delivers a keyboard event for the physical button.

If a remappable event is delivered but ignored, add support for that event and regression coverage; if the firmware/OS consumes it before the hook, document the boundary rather than adding a code workaround.
verification: Verify the physical airplane-mode button is captured and can be remapped when Windows exposes a keyboard event.
Confirm Fn+F8 behavior and airplane-mode system behavior remain unchanged.

confidence.rationale: The report identifies a device and distinguishes the physical hotkey from Fn+F8, but it is from 0.92.1 and does not show what event reaches Windows on a current build.

comment.body:
Thanks for identifying the IdeaPad 5 Pro 14ARH7 and noting that Fn+F8 is detected while the physical airplane-mode key toggles airplane mode. The report lists PowerToys 0.92.1. Could you please:
1. Retest on the latest stable v0.102.3001 and state the laptop's current Fn/hotkey mode.
2. In the Keyboard Manager capture dialog, test the physical airplane-mode button and Fn+F8 separately and report what each is detected as.
3. If the physical key remains undetected, comment `/bugreport` immediately after the test.
This will show whether Windows delivers a remappable keyboard event or handles the button as a firmware/system hotkey.
